-- Showcases with both fragile items AND at least 1 serious maintenance issue
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT msc."case_ID")
FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
WHERE cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac2
    JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca2 ON ac2."ARTregID" = ca2."art_exam"
    WHERE ca2."case_exam" = msc."case_ID" AND ac2."conserve_status" IN ('Poor', 'Critical')
);

-- Showcases with multiple serious maintenance issues AND fragile items
SELECT msc."case_ID", 
       COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) as issue_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac2
        JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca2 ON ac2."ARTregID" = ca2."art_exam"
        WHERE ca2."case_exam" = msc."case_ID" AND ac2."conserve_status" IN ('Poor', 'Critical')) as fragile_count
FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
WHERE cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) > 1
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac2
    JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca2 ON ac2."ARTregID" = ca2."art_exam"
    WHERE ca2."case_exam" = msc."case_ID" AND ac2."conserve_status" IN ('Poor', 'Critical')
)
ORDER BY msc."case_ID";

-- Check how many showcases have High sensitivity artifacts AND multiple serious issues
SELECT msc."case_ID", 
       COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) as issue_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac2
        JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca2 ON ac2."ARTregID" = ca2."art_exam"
        WHERE ca2."case_exam" = msc."case_ID" 
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SensitivityData" sd WHERE sd."ART_link" = ac2."ARTregID" AND sd."ENVsense" = 'High')) as fragile_count
FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
WHERE cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) > 1
ORDER BY msc."case_ID";

-- All showcases with their issue counts and fragile counts
SELECT sc."caseID", 
       COALESCE(iss.issue_count, 0) as issue_count,
       COALESCE(frag.fragile_count, 0) as fragile_count
FROM "Showcases" sc
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT msc."case_ID", COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) as issue_count
    FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
    JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
    WHERE cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
    GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
) iss ON sc."caseID" = iss."case_ID"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ca2."case_exam", COUNT(*) as fragile_count
    FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac2
    JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca2 ON ac2."ARTregID" = ca2."art_exam"
    WHERE ac2."conserve_status" IN ('Poor', 'Critical')
    GROUP BY ca2."case_exam"
) frag ON sc."caseID" = frag."case_exam"
WHERE iss.issue_count > 1
ORDER BY sc."caseID";

-- Count different types of issues per showcase
SELECT msc."case_ID", 
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.incident_stat = 'Open') as open_incidents,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.drill_stat = 'Overdue') as overdue_drills,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.train_stat = 'Overdue') as overdue_training,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.budget_stat IN ('Depleted', 'Limited')) as budget_issues
FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
HAVING (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.incident_stat = 'Open')) +
       (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.drill_stat = 'Overdue')) +
       (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.train_stat = 'Overdue')) +
       (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.budget_stat IN ('Depleted', 'Limited'))) > 1
ORDER BY msc."case_ID"
LIMIT 40;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT msc."case_ID"
    FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
    JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
    GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
    HAVING (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.incident_stat = 'Open')) +
           (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.drill_stat = 'Overdue')) +
           (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.train_stat = 'Overdue')) +
           (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cmon.budget_stat IN ('Depleted', 'Limited'))) > 1
) sub;

-- Count showcases with treat_stat != 'Not Required' AND prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT msc."case_ID")
FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
WHERE cmon.treat_stat NOT IN ('Not Required') AND cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent');

-- Check showcases with Critical status items AND multiple High/Urgent issues
SELECT msc."case_ID", 
       COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) as issue_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac2
        JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca2 ON ac2."ARTregID" = ca2."art_exam"
        WHERE ca2."case_exam" = msc."case_ID" AND ac2."conserve_status" = 'Critical') as critical_count
FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
WHERE cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) > 1
ORDER BY msc."case_ID";

-- All showcases with at least 1 High/Urgent issue, include case_ID, issue_count, fragile_count (Poor/Critical)
SELECT msc."case_ID", 
       COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) as issue_count,
       COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac2
                 JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca2 ON ac2."ARTregID" = ca2."art_exam"
                 WHERE ca2."case_exam" = msc."case_ID" AND ac2."conserve_status" IN ('Poor', 'Critical')), 0) as fragile_count
FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
WHERE cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
ORDER BY msc."case_ID";

-- Check: fragile = High sensitivity AND Poor/Critical status
SELECT msc."case_ID", 
       COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) as issue_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac2
        JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca2 ON ac2."ARTregID" = ca2."art_exam"
        WHERE ca2."case_exam" = msc."case_ID" 
        AND ac2."conserve_status" IN ('Poor', 'Critical')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SensitivityData" sd WHERE sd."ART_link" = ac2."ARTregID" AND sd."ENVsense" = 'High')) as fragile_count
FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
WHERE cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) > 1
ORDER BY msc."case_ID";

-- Check showcases with multiple serious issues and count organic material fragile items
SELECT msc."case_ID", 
       COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) as issue_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac2
        JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca2 ON ac2."ARTregID" = ca2."art_exam"
        WHERE ca2."case_exam" = msc."case_ID" 
        AND ac2."MatKind" IN ('Wood', 'Textile', 'Paper')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SensitivityData" sd WHERE sd."ART_link" = ac2."ARTregID" AND sd."ENVsense" = 'High')) as fragile_count
FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
WHERE cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) > 1
ORDER BY msc."case_ID";

-- Check showcases with Overdue maint_status AND Replace Now filter_status
SELECT sc."caseID", 
       sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' as ms,
       sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' as fs,
       sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' as ss
FROM "Showcases" sc
WHERE sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' IN ('Overdue')
   OR sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now'
GROUP BY sc."caseID", sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'maint_status',
         sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'filter_status',
         sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'silica_status'
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY sc."caseID"
LIMIT 40;

-- Count how many different maintenance indicators are in bad state per showcase
SELECT sc."caseID",
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 END) as overdue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 END) as replace_now,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' LIKE '%Replace%' THEN 1 END) as silica_replace
FROM "Showcases" sc
GROUP BY sc."caseID"
HAVING (CASE WHEN sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' LIKE '%Replace%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 1
ORDER BY sc."caseID"
LIMIT 40;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT sc."caseID"
    FROM "Showcases" sc
    WHERE (CASE WHEN sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
           CASE WHEN sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
           CASE WHEN sc."case_environment_profile"->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' LIKE '%Replace%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 1
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Showcases"

-- Let me check if there's a direct link between artifacts and showcases via ConditionAssessments
SELECT ca."case_exam", COUNT(DISTINCT ac."ARTregID") as artifact_count
FROM "ConditionAssessments" ca
JOIN "ArtifactsCore" ac ON ca."art_exam" = ac."ARTregID"
GROUP BY ca."case_exam"

-- All showcases with fragile items (Poor/Critical), including their serious issue count
SELECT ca."case_exam", 
       COUNT(DISTINCT ac."ARTregID") as fragile_count,
       COALESCE(iss.issue_count, 0) as issue_count
FROM "ConditionAssessments" ca
JOIN "ArtifactsCore" ac ON ca."art_exam" = ac."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT msc."case_ID", COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) as issue_count
    FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
    JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
    WHERE cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
    GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
) iss ON ca."case_exam" = iss."case_ID"
WHERE ac."conserve_status" IN ('Poor', 'Critical')
GROUP BY ca."case_exam", iss.issue_count
HAVING COALESCE(iss.issue_count, 0) > 1
ORDER BY ca."case_exam";

-- All showcases with fragile items AND at least 1 serious issue
SELECT ca."case_exam", 
       COUNT(DISTINCT ac."ARTregID") as fragile_count,
       COALESCE(iss.issue_count, 0) as issue_count
FROM "ConditionAssessments" ca
JOIN "ArtifactsCore" ac ON ca."art_exam" = ac."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT msc."case_ID", COUNT(DISTINCT cmon.maint_id) as issue_count
    FROM "ConservationAndMaintenance" cmon 
    JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msc ON cmon.monitor_link = msc."mon_ID"
    WHERE cmon.prio_tag IN ('High', 'Urgent')
    GROUP BY msc."case_ID"
) iss ON ca."case_exam" = iss."case_ID"
WHERE ac."conserve_status" IN ('Poor', 'Critical')
GROUP BY ca."case_exam", iss.issue_count
